tool_description: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that operates in the terminal, IDE, and desktop application. It autonomously reads codebases, edits files across multiple directories, runs shell commands, manages Git workflows, and iterates on results without manual context selection. On Windows, Claude Code is available natively via PowerShell/CMD installers, WinGet, a standalone Desktop app, and IDE extensions for VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains. It also supports WSL as a legacy fallback. Claude Code connects to Anthropic's API and supports third-party model providers (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) for organizations with specific compliance requirements. It includes MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for integrating external tools such as Jira, Slack, and Google Drive. Under Commercial Terms (Team, Enterprise, API), Anthropic does not use code, prompts, or outputs for model training. Use of Claude Code is restricted to corporate devices only, per ReSolve's AI policy in Orion.

data_protection.details: ON by default for consumer plans. Users can toggle off via claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls. When training is allowed, data may be retained up to 5 years. When training is disallowed, retention is 30 days.

OFF by default. Anthropic contractually commits not to use code, prompts, or outputs for training generative models under Commercial Terms of Service. Customers may voluntarily opt in via the Development Partner Program.
TLS encryption for all connections between Claude Code client and Anthropic API. Telemetry services (Statsig, Sentry) also use TLS in transit.
AES-256 encryption at the storage layer for all data at rest, including telemetry services.
Up to 5 years when model training is enabled.
30 days when model training is disabled.

30 days standard. API logs retained for 7 days. Zero Data Retention available with appropriately configured API keys. Enterprise plans support configurable custom retention periods. Bug reports submitted via /bug command are retained up to 5 years.
Inputs/outputs flagged for usage policy violations may be retained up to 2 years. Trust and safety scores retained up to 7 years.

Infrastructure primarily located in the United States. No user-configurable data residency by default. Custom EU data residency available for Enterprise customers via sales engagement. Regional processing available through AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI cloud partner endpoints.

API key-based authentication for API tier. SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and audit logging available on Enterprise plan. Team plan includes workspace-level access management. Consumer tiers use individual account authentication.

Non-essential telemetry (Statsig, Sentry, bug reports, surveys) can be disabled individually or all at once via CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1. When using third-party providers (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI), all non-essential traffic is disabled by default.
